messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer shell to solve programming tasks.

<pr_description>
Consider the following PR description:
Ordering problem in admin.RelatedFieldListFilter and admin.RelatedOnlyFieldListFilter
Description
	
RelatedFieldListFilter doesn't fall back to the ordering defined in Model._meta.ordering. 
Ordering gets set to an empty tuple in ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/2.2.1/django/contrib/admin/filters.py#L196 and unless ordering is defined on the related model's ModelAdmin class it stays an empty tuple. IMHO it should fall back to the ordering defined in the related model's Meta.ordering field.
RelatedOnlyFieldListFilter doesn't order the related model at all, even if ordering is defined on the related model's ModelAdmin class.
That's because the call to field.get_choices ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/2.2.1/django/contrib/admin/filters.py#L422 omits the ordering kwarg entirely.

</pr_description>

import re

# Read the original file
with open('/testbed/django/contrib/admin/filters.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# The old RelatedFieldListFilter.field_choices method
old_field_choices = '''    def field_choices(self, field, request, model_admin):
        ordering = ()
        related_admin = model_admin.admin_site._registry.get(field.remote_field.model)
        if related_admin is not None:
            ordering = related_admin.get_ordering(request)
        return field.get_choices(include_blank=False, ordering=ordering)'''

# The new RelatedFieldListFilter.field_choices method with fallback to Meta.ordering
new_field_choices = '''    def field_admin_ordering(self, field, request, model_admin):
        """
        Return the model admin's ordering for related field's choices.
        """
        related_admin = model_admin.admin_site._registry.get(field.remote_field.model)
        if related_admin is not None:
            ordering = related_admin.get_ordering(request)
            if ordering:
                return ordering
        return field.remote_field.model._meta.ordering

    def field_choices(self, field, request, model_admin):
        ordering = self.field_admin_ordering(field, request, model_admin)
        return field.get_choices(include_blank=False, ordering=ordering)'''

# Replace the old method with the new one
content = content.replace(old_field_choices, new_field_choices)

# The old RelatedOnlyFieldListFilter.field_choices method
old_related_only = '''class RelatedOnlyFieldListFilter(RelatedFieldListFilter):
    def field_choices(self, field, request, model_admin):
